process.h2: How College Movers Work in Boston

steps.title: Send the Dates
steps.text: Your move-out date, both addresses and roughly what's going. Mention if storage is part of it.

steps.title: Get the Price Explained
steps.text: Local moves are billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added. A manager covers the booking terms.

steps.title: Load Up
steps.text: The crew wraps furniture, carries boxes down and loads the truck, dorm rules and loading times included.

steps.title: Deliver or Store
steps.text: Straight to the new place, or into storage until the date you need it delivered.

faqHeading: College Movers FAQ for Boston Students and Parents

faq.q: How much do college movers in Boston cost?
faq.a: A local student move is billed hourly, with travel time from our yard added, and a 2-hour minimum that includes travel time. Small dorm moves often stay close to that minimum.

faq.q: Can you store my things over the summer?
faq.a: Yes. We pick up at move-out, store your things and deliver when the fall lease starts. Storage is priced by the cubic feet your items take up.

faq.q: Can a parent book the move for a student?
faq.a: Yes. Anyone can request the quote. Just give us the student's addresses and a phone number for moving day.

faq.q: When should I book a September 1 move?
faq.a: As early as you can. So many Boston leases turn over on September 1 that late August and September are our busiest weeks.

faq.q: Do you follow dorm move-out rules?
faq.a: Yes. Send us the building's loading times and rules when you book, and the crew plans the move inside them.

faq.q: Can you move me home after graduation?
faq.a: Yes. A move from Boston to another state is a long distance move, quoted at a flat rate and carried on our own trucks. Send your date and the home address and the manager prices it.

faqClosing: Still have a question about a student move? Our FAQ page covers billing, booking and moving day.

closing.h2: Start Your Student Move in Boston
closing.body: Send your move-out date, both addresses and whether you need storage. You'll know how the price works before the crew arrives, and the same company handles the storage if you need it.
